description.narrative: The IFC Financing will help finance the Companys solar and flat glass capex including refinancing of short-term loans availed for its implementation and working capital needs in Türkiye.

The Project has an Anticipated Impact Measurement and Monitoring (AIMM) rating of Good with a score of 52. The expected project-level outcomes are (i) environmental / climate effects: reduction of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through investments in solar supply chain (solar glass) and efficiency improvements through cold repair of existing flat glass furnace; and (ii) economy-wide effects: foreign exchange savings, skilled job creation and domestic value addition due to production of higher margin goods. The anticipated market-level outcome is the enhancement of Turkish glass manufacturing sectors adoption of practices that are not yet fully mainstreamed in the sector such as water use standards and gender inclusive practices or female employees. The investment has the potential to catalyze a broader market shift towards development impact-related financial instruments such as incentive-based loans, sustainability-linked loans, and bonds for other Turkish manufacturers in his sector through demonstration and replication effects.
